description: This file defines the ThemeService class which manages theme-related functionalities such as retrieving theme images, variables, and URLs for branding assets. It interacts with a data access object (ThemeDao), caches theme data, and provides derived CSS variables for theming.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: A service class providing functionalities to manage themes, including retrieving theme assets, variables, and implementing cache management for branding purposes.

methods.name: getThemeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ThemeDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getScssHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of ScssHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getImageETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for a given theme image key from cache.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves a ThemeImage object for a given image key from cache or loads it if necessary.

methods.name: getImageETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Fetches the image and its ETag, caching both, for a given image key.

methods.name: getCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns the current theme's CSS variables, either from cache or by fetching and deriving them.

methods.name: showSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Determines if social media icons should be shown based on theme settings.

methods.name: getDerivedCssVariables
methods.description: Generates an array of CSS variable definitions based on theme variables, including color manipulations.

methods.name: getClientLogoURL
methods.description: Builds the URL for the client logo image, using cache if available.

methods.name: getClientBannerURL
methods.description: Builds the URL for the client banner image, using cache if available.

methods.name: getLoginBannerURL
methods.description: Builds the URL for the login banner image, using cache if available.
